title: Accurate Models of AMD Matrix Cores

paragraphs.en: Matrix multipliers available on recent GPUs do not conform with the IEEE 754 floating point standard. Features of matrix multipliers differ across vendors and architectures of the same vendor, such as accumulator width, rounding behaviour, normalisation points, intermediate underflow and overflow logic, the handling of subnormals, and the treatment of special inputs. As a result, reproducibility of small matrix multiplier results across devices is not possible and cannot be achieved by software control. Implementation details of matrix multipliers are not documented, making it difficult to interpret discrepancies in the computed results. We characterise the numerical behaviour of matrix multipliers across three AMD GPU architectures: CDNA 1, CDNA 2, and CDNA 3, using the MI100, MI210/250, and MI300A/300X GPUs, respectively. We design test vectors to target numerical features for all supported input formats and provide the derivation and the reasoning for why each vector allows to determine a particular numerical feature based on the outputs of the devices. MATLAB-based software models of the matrix multipliers are then developed for each architecture and validated for bit-level reproducibility against hardware using a randomized test suite consisting of 10 million sets of random input vectors. To achieve this, we applied a previously developed technique to iteratively refine the accuracy of the models in a loop, by randomized testing followed by test-refinement until the model matches the hardware for every test case. Finally, as a proof of concept for what experimental research can be done with the models, we have utilised them in two demonstrative numerical applications, quantifying application-level accuracy differences between AMD matrix cores and the NVIDIA tensor cores.
paragraphs.zh: 近期 GPU 上可用的矩阵乘法器不符合 IEEE 754 浮点标准。 矩阵乘法器的特性在不同厂商之间以及同一厂商的不同架构之间各不相同，例如累加器宽度、舍入行为、归一化点、中间下溢和上溢逻辑、对次正规数的处理，以及对特殊输入的处理。 其结果是，小型矩阵乘法器的结果无法在不同设备之间复现，且无法通过软件控制来实现复现。 矩阵乘法器的实现细节没有文档记录，这使得解释计算结果中的差异变得困难。 我们分别使用 MI100、MI210/250 和 MI300A/300X GPU，对三种 AMD GPU 架构（CDNA 1、CDNA 2 和 CDNA 3）上矩阵乘法器的数值行为进行了表征。 我们设计了测试向量，以针对所有受支持输入格式的数值特性，并提供每个向量为何能够根据设备输出确定特定数值特性的推导和理由。 随后，我们为每种架构开发了基于 MATLAB 的矩阵乘法器软件模型，并使用由 1000 万组随机输入向量组成的随机化测试套件，针对硬件验证了这些模型的位级可复现性。 为实现这一点，我们采用了一种先前开发的技术，在循环中迭代细化模型的精度：先进行随机化测试，再进行测试细化，直到模型在每个测试用例上都与硬件匹配。 最后，作为利用这些模型可开展实验性研究的概念验证，我们将它们用于两个示范性数值应用，量化了 AMD 矩阵核心与 NVIDIA 张量核心之间在应用层面的精度差异。

paragraphs.en: The software associated with this paper, the MATLAB Tensor Core v0.6, which includes all three CDNA architecture matrix core models as well as many NVIDIA tensor core models and a generalised model that can be used to instantiate custom variants of matrix multipliers, is available on GitHub: https://github.com/north-numerical-computing/MATLAB-tensor-core .

paragraphs.en: Early work by Hickmann and Bradford ( Hickmann and Bradford, 2019 ) on the NVIDIA V100 GPU showed how to determine several numerical features of matrix multipliers that were not documented, such as the rounding mode and internal precision of the accumulator. Subsequently, ( Fasi et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Valpey et al., 2025 ) conducted experiments on the successors to the V100, the A100, T4, and the H100, as well as GPUs from AMD, the MI100, and MI250X, demonstrating differences between the V100, A100 and H100, for example, in the accumulator’s precision within the dot products, by showing that 24-bit, 25-bit and 26-bit accumulation was used, respectively. Due to the absence of documented numerical behaviour, existing software-based matrix multiplier models may fail to accurately represent hardware implementations. In many cases, simulations rely on IEEE-compliant models, which do not faithfully capture the behaviour of these specialised units. Developing accurate software models is therefore essential—not only for understanding hardware behaviour but also for enabling reliable scientific computing and ensuring consistency across diverse platforms.
paragraphs.zh: Hickmann 和 Bradford（Hickmann and Bradford, 2019）在 NVIDIA V100 GPU 上的早期工作展示了如何确定矩阵乘法器若干未被文档记录的数值特性，例如舍入模式和累加器的内部精度。 随后，（Fasi et al., 2021; Li et al., 2024; Valpey et al., 2025）在 V100 的后继产品 A100、T4 和 H100，以及 AMD 的 MI100 和 MI250X GPU 上进行了实验，证明了 V100、A100 和 H100 之间的差异，例如点积运算中累加器的精度差异，分别使用了 24 位、25 位和 26 位累加。 由于缺乏文档化的数值行为，现有的基于软件的矩阵乘法器模型可能无法准确表示硬件实现。 在许多情况下，仿真依赖于符合 IEEE 标准的模型，而这些模型并不能忠实地刻画这些专用运算单元的行为。 因此，开发准确的软件模型至关重要——这不仅有助于理解硬件行为，还能支持可靠的科学计算，并确保跨不同平台的一致性。

paragraphs.en: In our previous work ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) we investigated the numerical features of NVIDIA tensor cores. Using a combination of test vectors targeting specific floating-point behaviours and the generalised numerical feature testing (GNFT) framework from ( A. Khattak and Mikaitis, 2025 ) , we identified a wide range of numerical features. While most features were extracted using GNFT, some required ensemble-based random testing, revealing new features that require the refinement of the models. This study covered multiple architectures, including Volta, Ampere, Ada Lovelace, Hopper, and Blackwell. Based on these findings, we developed MATLAB-based models that achieve bit-level accuracy and allow both architecture-specific and user-defined configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们之前的工作（Khattak 和 Mikaitis，2026）中，我们研究了 NVIDIA 张量核心的数值特性。 通过结合针对特定浮点行为的测试向量与（A. Khattak 和 Mikaitis，2025）中的广义数值特性测试（GNFT）框架，我们识别出了大量的数值特性。 虽然大多数特性是通过 GNFT 提取的，但有一些需要基于集成的随机测试，从而揭示了需要改进模型的新特性。 本研究涵盖了多种架构，包括 Volta、Ampere、Ada Lovelace、Hopper 和 Blackwell。 基于这些发现，我们开发了基于 MATLAB 的模型，这些模型能够达到位级精度，并允许架构特定配置和用户自定义配置。

paragraphs.en: We investigate matrix multipliers on AMD GPUs across CDNA 1 (MI100), CDNA 2 (MI210, MI250), and CDNA 3 (MI300A, MI300X) architectures. Where previous literature ( Xie et al., 2025 ) only specified the behaviour, we provide a detailed characterisation of their numerical features, together with test vectors and explanations of their effectiveness. This enables the testing methodology to be extended to future AMD architectures. Our findings also reveal differences from the characterisation reported in ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , which we discuss in detail in the paper. The repository accompanying ( Xie et al., 2025 ) on GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/microsoft/MMA-Sim , however, is consistent with our findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了跨 CDNA 1（MI100）、CDNA 2（MI210、MI250）和 CDNA 3（MI300A、MI300X）架构的 AMD GPU 上的矩阵乘法器。 已有文献（Xie et al., 2025）仅说明了其行为，而我们则对其数值特性进行了详细的刻画，并提供了测试向量及其有效性的解释。 这使得该测试方法能够扩展到未来的 AMD 架构。 我们的发现还揭示了与（Xie et al., 2025）中报告的刻画不同的差异，我们在论文中对此进行了详细讨论。 然而，（Xie et al., 2025）在 GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/microsoft/MMA-Sim 上随附的代码库与我们的发现是一致的。

paragraphs.en: We develop MATLAB-based software models for all three CDNA architectures with flexibility to alter various features for numerical experimentation. We expanded the MATLAB Tensor Core software, which previously consisted of more than 10 models of NVIDIA GPU tensor cores ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) , with CDNA matrix cores.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为全部三种 CDNA 架构开发了基于 MATLAB 的软件模型，可灵活改变各种特性以进行数值实验。 我们将 MATLAB Tensor Core 软件扩展，加入了 CDNA 矩阵核心，该软件此前包含超过 10 种 NVIDIA GPU 张量核心模型（Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the impact of these differences using multi-word arithmetic for emulating high-precision GEMM via low precision ( Mary and Mikaitis, 2025 ) and broadband signal-processing algorithm ( Redif et al., 2015 ) , where GEMMs constitute the dominant computational workload.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过多词算术来展示这些差异的影响，用于模拟通过低精度实现的高精度 GEMM（Mary and Mikaitis, 2025）以及宽带信号处理算法（Redif et al., 2015），其中 GEMM 构成了主要计算负载。

paragraphs.en: The operations in ( 1 ) can be implemented either as a sequential fused multiply–accumulate (SFMA) or using a hardware-supported multi-term floating-point addition strategy ( Mikaitis, 2024 ; Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ; Tenca, 2009 ; Alexandridis and Dimitrakopoulos, 2025 ) . Moreover, multiple implementations of multi-term floating-point addition exist ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) . Such implementations may employ additional alignment bits during significand alignment, which we denote by n eab {n_{\mathrm{eab}}} . For architectures that accumulate the c c term early, n eab {n_{\mathrm{eab}}} directly represents the number of additional alignment bits. In contrast, for architectures that accumulate c c after the product accumulation (late accumulation), this interpretation does not apply directly. In this case, n eab {n_{\mathrm{eab}}} refers only to the alignment of the product terms, whereas the alignment of c c with the accumulated product sum, whether normalized or denormalized, is described explicitly for each architecture. Throughout this work, for any many-term dot-product accumulation, we define the number of product terms accumulated in a single multi-term addition, regardless of late or early c c accumulation, as the FMA size ( N FMA {N_{\mathrm{FMA}}} ) ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) . Throughout this paper, the term fractional bits is used exclusively to denote the fractional-bit component of a fixed-point representation.

paragraphs.en: Numerical feature testing ( A. Khattak and Mikaitis, 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Fasi et al., 2021 ; Hickmann and Bradford, 2019 ) relies on a predefined numerical feature space and then uses targeted feature test vectors to determine whether particular features are present in a given matrix or tensor core architecture. While features may naturally exhibit interdependencies, targeted feature testing alone cannot be considered entirely reliable. Moreover, if a feature present in the hardware is not included in the feature space, it cannot be identified by targeted tests restricted to that space.
paragraphs.zh: 数值特征测试（A. Khattak and Mikaitis, 2025；Li et al., 2024；Fasi et al., 2021；Hickmann and Bradford, 2019）依赖于一个预定义的数值特征空间，然后使用针对性的特征测试向量来判断给定矩阵或张量核心架构中是否存在特定特征。 尽管特征之间可能天然存在相互依赖关系，但仅靠针对性特征测试并不能被视为完全可靠。 此外，如果硬件中存在的某个特征未被纳入特征空间，那么局限于该空间的针对性测试就无法识别它。

paragraphs.en: To address this limitation, we designed ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) an iterative model refinement strategy that combines numerical feature testing with randomized testing against actual hardware. The approach constructs a model from the currently identified features and compares its outputs with those of the hardware over carefully selected randomized test vector sets. A mismatch indicates that the current feature space or model is incomplete, prompting further investigation and the introduction of additional features into the refinement process. This iterative procedure continues until the model agrees with the hardware for the test vectors considered.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一局限性，我们设计了（Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026）一种迭代式模型精化策略，将数值特征测试与针对实际硬件的随机化测试相结合。 该方法根据当前已识别的特征构建模型，并将其输出与硬件在经过精心挑选的随机测试向量集上的输出进行比较。 若出现不匹配，则表明当前的特征空间或模型尚不完整，从而促使进一步研究，并在精化过程中引入更多特征。 这一迭代过程持续进行，直到模型在所考虑的测试向量上与硬件结果一致为止。

paragraphs.en: For the proposed modelling framework, we construct an initial comprehensive feature space by incorporating all features considered in ( A. Khattak and Mikaitis, 2025 ) , together with additional features identified in NVIDIA GPU tensor core architectures through randomized testing in ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) . We also include all features reported for AMD GPUs in ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . These features include, among others, product and accumulation precision, rounding mode, and the number of alignment bits used when aligning product significands. Because the input space of matrix core operations is prohibitively large to explore exhaustively, randomized testing requires an intelligent sampling strategy to efficiently identify discrepancies between the hardware and the model. Such discrepancies provide evidence of potentially missing numerical features and guide subsequent refinement of both the feature space and the model. In Section 5 , we discuss how such a finite set of test vectors is constructed.
paragraphs.zh: 对于所提出的建模框架，我们通过纳入 ( A. Khattak and Mikaitis, 2025 ) 中考虑的所有特征，以及 ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) 中通过随机化测试在 NVIDIA GPU 张量核心架构中识别出的其他特征，构建了一个初始的全面特征空间。 我们还纳入了 ( Xie et al., 2025 ) 中报告的 AMD GPU 的所有特征。 这些特征包括但不限于乘积与累加精度、舍入模式，以及对齐乘积尾数时所使用的对齐位数。 由于矩阵核心操作的输入空间过于庞大而无法穷尽探索，随机化测试需要一种智能采样策略来高效地识别硬件与模型之间的差异。 这类差异为可能缺失的数值特征提供了证据，并指导对特征空间和模型的后续改进。 在第 5 节中，我们讨论如何构建这样一个有限的测试向量集合。

paragraphs.en: We have analyzed compute DNA (CDNA) 1, 2 and 3 architectures in this paper by running numerical feature detection similar to ( A. Khattak and Mikaitis, 2025 ) . We have used MI100, MI210, MI250, MI300, and MI300X AMD data centre GPUs. In all CDNA architectures, matrix cores can be invoked via specific intrinsic MFMA instructions: mfma_In_shape_Out where In can take on fp32, fp16, and bf16 input formats while Out is strictly in fp32, and matrix shape is in format mxnxk which can take on values that vary with input formats. 2 2 2 Examples: ___builtin_amdgcn_mfma_f32_16x16x4f32 , ___builtin_amdgcn_mfma_f32_16x16x16f16

paragraphs.en: The results of these tests reveal full precision addition or correctly rounded accumulation, and therefore, theoretically we can say that n eab = ∞ {n_{\mathrm{eab}}}=\infty . These results are contrary to that reported by ( Li et al., 2024 ) that MI100 matrix cores have 3 3 extra alignment bits. Unlike the NVIDIA tensor cores, the denormalised-product feature is not relevant here because the accumulation is performed accurately. Consequently, this feature may not be directly testable, but it is also unnecessary, since n eab = ∞ {n_{\mathrm{eab}}}=\infty . Both positive and negative infinities are detected in the input i.e. a 1 = ± a_{1}=\pm Inf, b 1 = 1 ⇒ d = ± b_{1}=1\Rightarrow d=\pm Inf, and in case of both positive and negative infinities, the output is NaN with a negative sign i.e. a 1 = − a 2 = a_{1}=-a_{2}= Inf, b 1 = b 2 = 1 ⇒ d = − b_{1}=b_{2}=1\Rightarrow d=- NAN. paragraphs.en: Infinities are detected at the bf16 input stage, even when the corresponding product would not overflow in fp32 precision. For example, a 1 = ± 2 128 a_{1}=\pm 2^{128} , which represent infinity in bf16, and b 1 = 2 − 20 b_{1}=2^{-20} yields p 1 = ± 2 108 p_{1}=\pm 2^{108} , which is representable in fp32. Nevertheless, the computed result is d = ± ∞ d=\pm\infty . However, if the inputs are not infinities, the intermediate products are allowed to grow beyond 2 128 2^{128} without being mapped to infinities. For instance, we obtained d = 0 d=0 for p 1 = 2 129 p_{1}=2^{129} , p 2 = − 2 129 p_{2}=-2^{129} , generated via a 1 = 2 65 a_{1}=2^{65} , b 1 = 2 64 b_{1}=2^{64} , and a 2 = 2 65 a_{2}=2^{65} , b 2 = − 2 64 b_{2}=-2^{64} . This suggests that infinity detection occurs at the input level, whereas overflow during intermediate product accumulation is handled at the very end when sum is converted to fp32. On the opposite end of the dynamic range, where the product falls below the smallest normal fp32-representable magnitude, we observe from the output that d = ± 2 − 148 d=\pm 2^{-148} for c = ± 2 − 149 c=\pm 2^{-149} , p 1 = ± ∑ ℓ = 151 156 2 − ℓ p_{1}=\pm\sum_{\ell=151}^{156}2^{-\ell} , p 2 = ± 2 − 156 p_{2}=\pm 2^{-156} . This indicates that products smaller than 2 − 149 2^{-149} still participate in the computation and are not flushed to zero. Because CDNA 1 matrix cores manifest full-precision accumulator within the dot products, many of the features later tested on CDNA 2 and CDNA3, as well as those tested on NVIDIA tensor cores ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) , do not apply. With both + + Inf and − - Inf in inputs, the output is − - NaN, consistent with fp32 and fp16 input formats.
paragraphs.zh: 无穷大在 bf16 输入阶段即被检测出来，即使对应的乘积在 fp32 精度下并不会溢出。 例如，a_{1}=\pm 2^{128} 在 bf16 中表示无穷大，而 b_{1}=2^{-20} 得到 p_{1}=\pm 2^{108}，该值在 fp32 中是可表示的。 尽管如此，计算结果却是 d=\pm\infty。 然而，如果输入不是无穷大，则允许中间乘积增长到超过 2^{128} 而不被映射为无穷大。 例如，对于由 a_{1}=2^{65}、b_{1}=2^{64} 以及 a_{2}=2^{65}、b_{2}=-2^{64} 生成的 p_{1}=2^{129}、p_{2}=-2^{129}，我们得到的输出是 d=0。 这表明无穷大检测发生在输入层面，而中间乘积累加过程中的溢出则是在最后 sum 被转换为 fp32 时才处理。 在动态范围的另一端，即乘积低于 fp32 可表示的最小规格化数值时，我们从输出中观察到，当 c=\pm 2^{-149}、p_{1}=\pm\sum_{\ell=151}^{156}2^{-\ell}、p_{2}=\pm 2^{-156} 时，d=\pm 2^{-148}。 这表明小于 2^{-149} 的乘积仍然参与计算，并不会被清零。 由于 CDNA 1 矩阵核心在点乘内部使用全精度累加器，许多后来在 CDNA 2 和 CDNA 3 上测试的特性，以及在 NVIDIA 张量核心上测试的特性（Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026），在此并不适用。 当输入中同时包含 +Inf 和 -Inf 时，输出为 -NaN，这与 fp32 和 fp16 输入格式的情况一致。

paragraphs.en: Unlike CDNA1, and also the fp16 input format in CDNA2, the bf16 format introduces an additional subscript _1k in the MFMA intrinsic instruction for certain input matrix sizes. The matrix sizes that include this additional subscript are 32x32x4 , 16x16x4 , 4x4x4 , 32x32x8 , and 16x16x16 . The matrix sizes without this subscript are the same as those supported in the CDNA1 architecture. Similar to the fp16 case, the final rounding mode is RNE. The group-wise pair-sum test vectors listed for the fp16 case indicate a group size of 4 4 for the intrinsic instructions with the subscript _1k (see Figure 2 (a)), whereas for the remaining instructions the group size is 2 2 as depicted in Figure 2 (b).
paragraphs.zh: 与 CDNA1 不同，也不同于 CDNA2 中的 fp16 输入格式，bf16 格式在 MFMA 内建指令中针对某些输入矩阵尺寸引入了额外的下标 _1k。 包含该额外下标的矩阵尺寸为 32x32x4、16x16x4、4x4x4、32x32x8 和 16x16x16。 不带该下标的矩阵尺寸与 CDNA1 架构所支持的尺寸相同。 与 fp16 的情况类似，最终的舍入模式为 RNE。 针对 fp16 情况列出的成组两两求和测试向量表明，带下标 _1k 的内建指令的组大小为 4 4（见图 2 (a)），而其余指令的组大小为 2 2，如图 2 (b) 所示。

paragraphs.en: Next, given n eab ≥ 1 {n_{\mathrm{eab}}}\geq 1 , we perform the FMA size detection test with c = 1 c=1 , p 1 = 2 − 24 p_{1}=2^{-24} , p j = 2 − 24 p_{j}=2^{-24} and p i ≠ 1 & i ≠ j = 0 p_{i\neq 1\And i\neq j}=0 . We obtain d = 1 + 2 − 23 d=1+2^{-23} for j ≤ 8 j\leq 8 , indicating an N FMA = 8 {N_{\mathrm{FMA}}}=8 , which confirms the results reported in ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . To rule out the possibility that odd- and even-indexed products are added separately i.e. inter-leaved pattern as detected in ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ) , we permuted the values ± 1 \pm 1 , 0 0 , and ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 25 ) \pm(2^{-24}+2^{-25}) across p 1 p_{1} , p 2 p_{2} , and p 3 p_{3} . The resulting outputs were invariant, consistently yielding d = ± 1 d=\pm 1 which implies no interleaving. To confirm whether n eab = 1 {n_{\mathrm{eab}}}=1 or n eab > 1 {n_{\mathrm{eab}}}>1 , we used the test vector p 1 = ± 1 p_{1}=\pm 1 , p 2 = ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 24 − j ) p_{2}=\pm(2^{-24}+2^{-24-j}) . For j > 0 j>0 , we obtained d = ± 1 d=\pm 1 indicating that bits beyond the 24th fractional bit are truncated during alignment. Since the final rounding mode is RNE, if bits beyond 24 24 th bit were not truncated, the output would not be ± 1 \pm 1 . For instance, if bits beyond 25 25 th bit were truncated, d d would have been ± ( 1 + 2 − 23 ) \pm(1+2^{-23}) . Moreover, if it was a round up or down, or RNE at the alignment, d d cannot be equal to one for both positive or negative signs. With a single extra alignment bit, we tested whether a feature similar to NVIDIA tensor cores exists, where products remain denormalized. Using p 1 = 2.25 p_{1}=2.25 , p 2 = 2 − 23 p_{2}=2^{-23} , and p 3 = p 4 = 2 − 24 p_{3}=p_{4}=2^{-24} , we observed d = 2.25 + 2 − 22 d=2.25+2^{-22} for a 1 = b 1 = 1.5 a_{1}=b_{1}=1.5 . In contrast, when a 1 = 2.25 a_{1}=2.25 and b 1 = 1 b_{1}=1 , we obtained d = 2.25 d=2.25 . This suggests that products are computed as the product of significands multiplied by 2 ( sum of exponents ) 2^{(\text{sum of exponents})} and are kept denormalised while being accumulated. To check whether c c is aligned and added together with the products, we set c = 1 c=1 , p 1 = p 2 = 2 − 25 p_{1}=p_{2}=2^{-25} , and p 3 = 2 − 24 p_{3}=2^{-24} . We obtained d = 1 + 2 − 23 d=1+2^{-23} , indicating that c c is added after product accumulation; otherwise, we would have obtained d = c d=c because n eab = 1 {n_{\mathrm{eab}}}=1 and final rounding mode is RNE.

paragraphs.en: The observation that the shifted S p i , sum {S_{p_{i},\mathrm{sum}}} is rounded down to 32 fractional bits contradicts the 31 fractional bits reported in ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , yet it surprisingly matches the behaviour implemented in the associated repository. The observation from earlier test that d = 1 + 2 − 23 d=1+2^{-23} for j < 8 j<8 and d = 1 d=1 for j ≥ 8 j\geq 8 cannot be attributed to a 31 31 -bit alignment precision. With alignment-stage RD confirmed to retain 32 32 fractional bits, the apparent 31 31 -bit behaviour instead arises from a subsequent RD operation applied to the normalised accumulated significand S acc S_{\mathrm{acc}} before the final RNE step. paragraphs.en: In CDNA 3 additional MFMA instructions are available: f32_16x16x8_xf32 and f32_16x16x4_xf32 . These instructions accept float inputs but internally reduce the mantissa to 10 10 bits. This behaviour was verified experimentally by setting a 1 = 1 + 2 − 10 + 2 − 11 a_{1}=1+2^{-10}+2^{-11} and b 1 = ± 1 b_{1}=\pm 1 , which produced d = ± ( 1 + 2 − 10 ) d=\pm(1+2^{-10}) , reflecting truncation, instead of ± ( 1 + 2 − 9 ) \pm(1+2^{-9}) which would reflect an application of RNE. The N FMA = 4 {N_{\mathrm{FMA}}}=4 in this input format, which matches with that of Ampere and Ada family GPUs tensor cores while that for Hopper and Blackwell, it is 8. We also confirm that when c = 0 c=0 the exponent of c c is equal to − 126 -126 in this input format as well.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CDNA 3 中提供了额外的 MFMA 指令：f32_16x16x8_xf32 和 f32_16x16x4_xf32。 这些指令接受浮点输入，但在内部将尾数缩减至 10 10 位。 通过设置 a 1 = 1 + 2 − 10 + 2 − 11 a_{1}=1+2^{-10}+2^{-11} 和 b 1 = ± 1 b_{1}=\pm 1 进行了实验验证，结果产生 d = ± ( 1 + 2 − 10 ) d=\pm(1+2^{-10})，这反映了截断行为，而不是会反映 RNE（舍入到最近偶数）应用的 ± ( 1 + 2 − 9 ) \pm(1+2^{-9})。 在这种输入格式下 N FMA = 4 {N_{\mathrm{FMA}}}=4，这与 Ampere 和 Ada 系列 GPU 的张量核心一致，而 Hopper 和 Blackwell 则为 8。 我们还确认，当 c = 0 c=0 时，在这种输入格式下 c c 的指数同样等于 − 126 -126。

paragraphs.en: To analyse the addition of c c , we permute the values ± 1 \pm 1 and ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 24 − i ) \pm\big(2^{-24}+2^{-24-i}\big) between c c and p 1 p_{1} , for i = 0 , … , 10 i=0,\dots,10 . Similar behaviour to the fp16 and bf16 cases is observed: The shifted significand is rounded down to 24 fractional bits when c c is shifted, and to 32 fractional bits when the accumulated odd-indexed product sum is shifted. Repeating this experiment with permutations between c c and p 2 p_{2} yields identical behaviour. To further investigate the treatment of c c when it is shifted entirely beyond the retained precision of the product sum, we fix p 1 = ± 1 p_{1}=\pm 1 and p 2 = 2 − 24 p_{2}=2^{-24} , while varying c = ± 2 − 24 − i c=\pm 2^{-24-i} . For i = 1 i=1 , the output is d = 1 d=1 for positive inputs and d = − ( 1 + 2 − 23 ) d=-(1+2^{-23}) for negative inputs, consistent with the behaviour observed previously. However, for i > 1 i>1 , the result becomes d = ± 1 d=\pm 1 in both cases. This indicates that once the entire significand of c c is shifted beyond the 25 25 th fractional bit of the accumulated product sum, truncation is applied instead of RD. The contrasting behaviour is observed when p 1 = ± 1 p_{1}=\pm 1 , and c = ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 25 − i ) c=\pm(2^{-24}+2^{-25-i}) , with i ≥ 0 i\geq 0 , for which the result is d = 1 d=1 for the positive and d = − 1 − 2 − 23 d=-1-2^{-23} for the negative case. The underlying reason is that part of the significand of c c remains within the first 25 25 -bit fractional bits of the product sum, allowing the round-down effect to occur.

sents.en: For i = 1 i=1 , the output is d = 1 d=1 for positive inputs and d = − ( 1 + 2 − 23 ) d=-(1+2^{-23}) for negative inputs, consistent with the behaviour observed previously.
sents.zh: 当 i = 1 i=1 时，正数输入的输出为 d = 1 d=1 ，负数输入的输出为 d = − ( 1 + 2 − 23 ) d=-(1+2^{-23}) ，与之前观察到的行为一致。

sents.en: However, for i > 1 i>1 , the result becomes d = ± 1 d=\pm 1 in both cases.
sents.zh: 然而，当 i > 1 i>1 时，两种情况下的结果都变为 d = ± 1 d=\pm 1 。

sents.en: This indicates that once the entire significand of c c is shifted beyond the 25 25 th fractional bit of the accumulated product sum, truncation is applied instead of RD.
sents.zh: 这表明，一旦 c c 的整个尾数被移位到累加乘积和的第 25 25 个小数位之外，就会采用截断而非 RD（向下舍入）。

sents.en: The contrasting behaviour is observed when p 1 = ± 1 p_{1}=\pm 1 , and c = ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 25 − i ) c=\pm(2^{-24}+2^{-25-i}) , with i ≥ 0 i\geq 0 , for which the result is d = 1 d=1 for the positive and d = − 1 − 2 − 23 d=-1-2^{-23} for the negative case.
The underlying reason is that part of the significand of c c remains within the first 25 25 -bit fractional bits of the product sum, allowing the round-down effect to occur.
sents.zh: 其根本原因在于 c c 的部分尾数仍位于乘积和的前 25 25 位小数位之内，从而使得向下舍入效应得以发生。

paragraphs.en: Finally, to determine whether odd- and even-indexed product sums are combined prior to adding c c , we set c = ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 25 ) c=\pm(2^{-24}+2^{-25}) and permute ± 1 \pm 1 and ± 2 − 25 \pm 2^{-25} between p 1 p_{1} and p 2 p_{2} , emulating odd- and even-indexed partial sums. This produces d = 1 d=1 for positive values and d = − ( 1 + 2 − 22 ) d=-(1+2^{-22}) for negative values. This confirms that odd- and even-indexed product sums are first accumulated, followed by the addition of c c . If any alternate ordering were present, at least one permutation would yield d = 1 + 2 − 23 d=1+2^{-23} for positive values. We obtained identical results for the cancellation test mentioned in Section 4.3.1 . However, the odd- and even-indexed product terms separate accumulation requires a unique test in which one of the product sums is zero but its corresponding exponent is the maximum. For example, we set c = 2 − 20 c=2^{-20} , a 1 = b 1 = 2 0 a_{1}=b_{1}=2^{0} , and a 2 = − a 4 = 2 5 a_{2}=-a_{4}=2^{5} , b 2 = b 4 = 1 b_{2}=b_{4}=1 , which results in d = 1 d=1 instead of d = 1 + 2 − 20 d=1+2^{-20} . Although the even-indexed product sum is zero, the maximum exponent against which c c is aligned is 4 4 , rather than 0 0 . Thus, the maximum exponent is used for alignment regardless of whether the corresponding significand sum is zero.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，为了确定奇数索引与偶数索引的乘积和是否在加上 c c 之前先被合并，我们设 c = ± ( 2 − 24 + 2 − 25 ) c=\pm(2^{-24}+2^{-25}) ，并在 p 1 p_{1} 与 p 2 p_{2} 之间对 ± 1 \pm 1 和 ± 2 − 25 \pm 2^{-25} 进行排列，以模拟奇数索引与偶数索引的部分和。 这在值为正时产生 d = 1 d=1 ，值为负时产生 d = − ( 1 + 2 − 22 ) d=-(1+2^{-22}) 。 这证实了奇数索引与偶数索引的乘积和是先累加，然后再加上 c c 。 如果存在任何其他顺序，那么至少有一种排列会使正值产生 d = 1 + 2 − 23 d=1+2^{-23} 。 对于 4.3.1 节中提到的抵消测试，我们得到了相同的结果。 然而，奇数索引与偶数索引乘积项分开累加的情况需要一个独特的测试，即其中一个乘积和为零但其对应的指数是最大值。 例如，我们设 c = 2 − 20 c=2^{-20} ， a 1 = b 1 = 2 0 a_{1}=b_{1}=2^{0} ， a 2 = − a 4 = 2 5 a_{2}=-a_{4}=2^{5} ， b 2 = b 4 = 1 b_{2}=b_{4}=1 ，结果得到 d = 1 d=1 而不是 d = 1 + 2 − 20 d=1+2^{-20} 。 尽管偶数索引的乘积和为零，但与 c c 对齐时所用的最大指数是 4 4 ，而不是 0 0 。 因此，无论相应的尾数和是否为零，对齐都使用最大指数。

sents.en: This produces d = 1 d=1 for positive values and d = − ( 1 + 2 − 22 ) d=-(1+2^{-22}) for negative values.
This confirms that odd- and even-indexed product sums are first accumulated, followed by the addition of c c .

sents.en: We obtained identical results for the cancellation test mentioned in Section 4.3.1 .
sents.zh: 对于 4.3.1 节中提到的抵消测试，我们得到了相同的结果。

sents.en: However, the odd- and even-indexed product terms separate accumulation requires a unique test in which one of the product sums is zero but its corresponding exponent is the maximum.

sents.zh: 尽管偶数索引的乘积和为零，但与 c c 对齐时所用的最大指数是 4 4 ，而不是 0 0 。

paragraphs.en: In the verification process, we first generate a set of random inputs to evaluate the GPU matrix cores, with the outputs written to a text file. The same random inputs are then generated in MATLAB to evaluate the corresponding matrix-core models, followed by a comparison between the GPU and model outputs. We perform this verification on the MI100, MI210 and MI250 for fp16 and bf16 input formats, and on the MI300A/X (CDNA 3) for Binary8 (E5M2 and E4M3), fp16, bf16, and tf19. In total, we perform nine verification tests in two sampling strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 在验证过程中，我们首先生成一组随机输入来评估 GPU 矩阵核心，并将输出写入文本文件。 然后在 MATLAB 中生成相同的随机输入来评估相应的矩阵核心模型，接着对 GPU 输出与模型输出进行比较。 我们在 MI100、MI210 和 MI250 上针对 fp16 和 bf16 输入格式执行此验证，并在 MI300A/X（CDNA 3）上针对 Binary8（E5M2 和 E4M3）、fp16、bf16 和 tf19 执行此验证。 总共，我们在两种采样策略下执行九项验证测试。

sents.en: In the verification process, we first generate a set of random inputs to evaluate the GPU matrix cores, with the outputs written to a text file.
sents.zh: 在验证过程中，我们首先生成一组随机输入来评估 GPU 矩阵核心，并将输出写入文本文件。

sents.en: The same random inputs are then generated in MATLAB to evaluate the corresponding matrix-core models, followed by a comparison between the GPU and model outputs.

sents.en: We perform this verification on the MI100, MI210 and MI250 for fp16 and bf16 input formats, and on the MI300A/X (CDNA 3) for Binary8 (E5M2 and E4M3), fp16, bf16, and tf19.

sents.en: In total, we perform nine verification tests in two sampling strategies.
sents.zh: 总共，我们在两种采样策略下执行九项验证测试。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward approach would be to draw a , b ∼ 𝒰 a,b\sim\mathcal{U} , where 𝒰 \mathcal{U} denotes the uniform distribution. However, such sampling does not yield a uniform distribution of floating-point exponents. Rather, the exponent distribution is biased towards larger values. To obtain a more uniform coverage of the floating-point exponent range, we generate the random vectors by sampling the significand uniformly in the range [ − 2 + 2 − f + 1 , 2 − 2 − f + 1 ] [-2+2^{-f+1},2-2^{-f+1}] , where f f denotes the precision of the considered input format, as defined in Table 1 . The corresponding exponents are drawn from a uniform integer distribution over the prescribed lower and upper bounds of the exponent range. The pseudo-code is outlined in Algorithm 3 . With this sampling strategy, all architectures considered are tested on the basis of the input format exponent ranges described below.
paragraphs.zh: 一种直接的做法是从 𝒰 a,b\sim\mathcal{U} 中抽取 a,b，其中 𝒰 \mathcal{U} 表示均匀分布。 然而，这样的采样并不能得到浮点指数上的均匀分布。 相反，指数分布会偏向较大的数值。 为了更均匀地覆盖浮点指数范围，我们通过在区间 [ − 2 + 2 − f + 1 , 2 − 2 − f + 1 ] [-2+2^{-f+1},2-2^{-f+1}] 内均匀采样尾数来生成随机向量，其中 f f 表示所考虑输入格式的精度，其定义见表 1。 相应的指数则从规定的指数范围下界和上界之间的均匀整数分布中抽取。 伪代码见算法 3。 采用这种采样策略，所有考虑的架构都基于下文所述的输入格式指数范围进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Across all configurations considered above, no mismatches were observed between the matrix-core model and the GPU outputs for CDNA 1 or CDNA 2, indicating that the feature space was sufficient for both sampling strategies. For CDNA 3, the independent bit-sampling strategy likewise produced no mismatches. However, the first sampling strategy revealed a small number of mismatches during model refinement, as touched upon in Section 4.3.1 . These mismatches occurred at different stages of the refinement process as successive updates were introduced. Due to the two-stage RD operation and the associated intermediate normalisation, the model required four refinement iterations in total, as summarised in Table 2 . The mismatches were progressively eliminated through these successive refinements. In the fourth refinement iteration, the validation was extended to N ens = 10 7 {N_{\mathrm{ens}}}=10^{7} across the full exponent range using the first sampling strategy for fp16, bf16, and tf32, and to 2 × 10 7 2\times 10^{7} for binary8. No mismatches were observed for any input format. For N ens = 10 6 {N_{\mathrm{ens}}}=10^{6} , each test required, on average, 13 ± 1.5 13\pm 1.5 minutes on the MATLAB side and 1 1 – 2 2 minutes on the GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 在上文考虑的所有配置中，矩阵核心模型与 GPU 输出在 CDNA 1 或 CDNA 2 上均未观察到不匹配，表明该特征空间对两种采样策略都足够。 对于 CDNA 3，独立位采样策略同样未产生任何不匹配。 然而，第一种采样策略在模型精化过程中揭示了少量不匹配，如 4.3.1 节所述。 这些不匹配出现在精化过程的不同阶段，随着 successive 更新的引入而产生。 由于两阶段 RD 操作及相关的中间归一化，该模型总共需要四次精化迭代，如表 2 所总结。 通过这些 successive 精化，不匹配被逐步消除。 在第四次精化迭代中，验证扩展到 N ens = 10 7 {N_{\mathrm{ens}}}=10^{7}，对 fp16、bf16 和 tf32 使用第一种采样策略覆盖完整指数范围，binary8 则扩展到 2 × 10 7 2\times 10^{7}。 对所有输入格式均未观察到不匹配。 对于 N ens = 10 6 {N_{\mathrm{ens}}}=10^{6}，每个测试平均在 MATLAB 侧需要 13 ± 1.5 13\pm 1.5 分钟，在 GPU 上需要 1 1 – 2 2 分钟。

paragraphs.en: While NVIDIA GPU numerical features have been reported in ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) , we briefly compare them with those of AMD GPUs in Table 3 . The table summarizes key numerical features across several generations of NVIDIA tensor cores and AMD matrix cores, including product alignment, the FMA size, handling of the addend c c , alignment and rounding of the accumulated product sum, and the minimum supported exponent. These features highlight the differences in accumulation, rounding, and precision handling across GPU MMA architectures. The table speaks for itself—the approaches of evaluating dot products and matrix multiplies of floating-point numbers, in hardware, differ significantly between the two major companies. This translates to numerical error accumulation differences, as shown in the demonstrative applications of Section 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 NVIDIA GPU 的数值特性已在 ( Khattak and Mikaitis, 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) 中有报道，我们在表 3 中简要地将它们与 AMD GPU 的数值特性进行比较。 该表总结了 NVIDIA 张量核心和 AMD 矩阵核心多代产品的关键数值特性，包括乘积的对齐、FMA 大小、对加数 c c 的处理、累加乘积和的对齐与舍入，以及支持的最小指数。 这些特性凸显了各 GPU MMA 架构在累加、舍入和精度处理方面的差异。 这张表本身足以说明问题——两家主要公司在硬件中评估浮点数点积和矩阵乘法的方式存在显著差异。 这转化为数值误差累积方面的差异，如第 8 节的演示性应用所示。

paragraphs.en: This section introduces MATLAB Matrix Core v0.6, comprising the extensions to the software developed as part of this research. The toolbox was developed in MATLAB R2026a and uses CPFloat ( Fasi and Mikaitis, 2023 ) for conversion from double- or single-precision formats to all supported input formats. The toolbox is structured around the generalised matrix multiplier model, which supports four main architectural configurations: correct_rounding , modelling a Kulisch-style correctly rounded accumulator such as CDNA 1; pair_wise_sum , modelling the pairwise accumulation used in CDNA 2; global_alignment , modelling the CDNA 3-like architecture for fp16, bf16, and tf32 inputs; and odd_even_grouping , modelling the CDNA 3-like architecture for binary8 inputs. Each configuration provides parameters to control the relevant architectural features, including N FMA {N_{\mathrm{FMA}}} , alignment and rounding behaviour, subnormal support, and exponent handling, thereby allowing both the AMD and alternative configurations to be simulated. With the Parallel Computing Toolbox available, matrix multiplications using the proposed models are parallelized across available CPU cores. The toolbox is also compatible with GNU Octave and can be accessed from Python via Oct2Py or the MATLAB Engine API. In future work, we will port the model back-end to C to improve performance. An example call of MI300A matrix core for a 4x4 matrix multiply accumulate is shown below.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍 MATLAB 矩阵核心 v0.6，包括作为本研究所开发的软件的扩展部分。 该工具箱在 MATLAB R2026a 中开发，并使用 CPFloat（Fasi 和 Mikaitis，2023）将双精度或单精度格式转换为所有支持的输入格式。 该工具箱围绕广义矩阵乘法器模型构建，该模型支持四种主要的架构配置：correct_rounding，对 Kulisch 式正确舍入累加器进行建模，例如 CDNA 1；pair_wise_sum，对 CDNA 2 中使用的两两累加进行建模；global_alignment，对 CDNA 3 类架构的 fp16、bf16 和 tf32 输入进行建模；以及 odd_even_grouping，对 CDNA 3 类架构的 binary8 输入进行建模。 每种配置都提供参数来控制相关的架构特性，包括 N FMA {N_{\mathrm{FMA}}}、对齐与舍入行为、次正规数支持以及指数处理，从而可以模拟 AMD 以及其他可选的配置。 在具备 Parallel Computing Toolbox 的情况下，使用所提出模型的矩阵乘法会在可用的 CPU 核心上并行化。 该工具箱还与 GNU Octave 兼容，并可通过 Oct2Py 或 MATLAB Engine API 从 Python 中访问。 在未来的工作中，我们将把模型后端移植到 C 语言以提高性能。 下面展示了针对 4x4 矩阵乘累加的 MI300A 矩阵核心的调用示例。

paragraphs.en: We have implemented an algorithm for emulating high-precision matrix multiplication via a multi-word representation of matrices in one of the low-precision formats supported by the AMD matrix cores. The details are provided by Mary and Mikaitis ( Mary and Mikaitis, 2025 ) . We have plotted three generations of the AMD CDNA GPUs and one of NVIDIA, for comparison. In each diagram, the number of words determines the accuracy of the conversion of input matrices between binary64 representation and a N N -word low-precision representation: larger N N means lower error in converting the binary64 inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现了一种算法，通过 AMD 矩阵核心所支持的一种低精度格式下的多字矩阵表示来模拟高精度矩阵乘法。 具体细节由 Mary 和 Mikaitis 提供（Mary and Mikaitis, 2025）。 我们绘制了三代 AMD CDNA GPU 和一款 NVIDIA GPU 的图以作比较。 在每张图中，字数决定了输入矩阵在 binary64 表示与 N N 字低精度表示之间转换的精度：N N 越大，转换 binary64 输入时的误差越低。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows the experiments with fp8-e5m2. The plot shows the relative norm-wise error as the inner dimension n n of two matrices being multiplied is increased. The main differences between the MI300X and the B200 appear when either the dimension n n is relatively large or when six words are used. This can be explained by the differences between these two devices as shown in Table 3 . Figures 5 and 6 show similar experiments for fp16 and bf16. With these formats, CDNA 1 and 2 can also be utilised. Overall, all CDNA matrix multipliers yield similar error in this matrix multiplication algorithm, whilst B200 consistently has a larger error which grows with n n . This behavior can be attributed to the fact that NVIDIA tensor cores use RTZ, whereas AMD matrix cores use RNE for the final rounding. In addition, AMD applies RD when aligning the accumulation term with the product sum. However, the effect of this asymmetric rounding is not pronounced because the accumulation term often exceeds the inner-product term. Consequently, RD becomes effective only beyond the 31st fractional bit, which provides sufficient precision to reduce the impact of its asymmetric behavior on the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了使用 fp8-e5m2 的实验。 该图显示了当两个相乘矩阵的内维度 n n 增大时的相对按范数误差。 MI300X 与 B200 之间的主要差异出现在维度 n n 相对较大或使用六个字（word）时。 这可以通过表 3 中所示的这两种设备之间的差异来解释。 图 5 和图 6 展示了针对 fp16 和 bf16 的类似实验。 采用这些格式时，CDNA 1 和 2 也可以被利用。 总体而言，所有 CDNA 矩阵乘法器在该矩阵乘法算法中都产生相似的误差，而 B200 始终具有更大的误差，且该误差随 n n 增长。 这种行为可以归因于以下事实：NVIDIA 张量核使用 RTZ，而 AMD 矩阵核对最终舍入使用 RNE。 此外，AMD 在将累加项与乘积和对齐时使用 RD。 然而，由于累加项通常超过内积项，这种非对称舍入的效果并不明显。 因此，RD 仅在第 31 个小数位之后才生效，这提供了足够的精度来降低其非对称行为对最终结果的影响。

paragraphs.en: Many signal processing algorithms rely heavily on GEMMs, including applications in tensor decomposition, polynomial matrix algebra, and multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. Here, we investigate the impact of reduced-precision GEMM implementations on the output of a sequential matrix diagonalisation (SMD) ( Redif et al., 2015 ) algorithm, a polynomial eigenvalue decomposition (PEVD) method used in broadband array processing applications ( d’Olne et al., 2025 ; Neo et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 许多信号处理算法高度依赖广义矩阵乘法（GEMM），包括张量分解、多项式矩阵代数以及多输入多输出（MIMO）系统等应用。 在此，我们研究了降精度 GEMM 实现对顺序矩阵对角化（SMD）（Redif et al., 2015）算法输出的影响，该算法是一种用于宽带阵列处理应用的多项式特征值分解（PEVD）方法（d’Olne et al., 2025; Neo et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: In this demonstration, in addition to CDNA 1, 2, and 3 architectures, we also consider the B200 NVIDIA GPU for both fp16 and bf16 input formats. The dominant eigenvalue and the condition number of the example polynomial matrix are shown in Figure 7 . Although no visible difference can be observed between the eigenvalue estimates obtained using different GEMM models, the difference is non-zero, as illustrated in Figure 8 and 9 . The frequency-dependent variations i.e., the dip around certain frequencies, are difficult to attribute to any particular feature because the error propagation depends on the repeated perturbation of the intermediate matrix 𝑫 ⁡ ( z ) {\boldsymbol{D}}(z) during subsequent SMD iterations. These perturbations may either accumulate towards or away from the reference solution at different frequencies, and therefore, require a separate analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在本演示中，除了 CDNA 1、2 和 3 架构之外，我们还针对 fp16 和 bf16 两种输入格式考虑了 NVIDIA B200 GPU。 该示例多项式矩阵的主特征值和条件数如图 7 所示。 尽管使用不同 GEMM 模型得到的特征值估计之间观察不到明显差异，但该差异并非为零，如图 8 和图 9 所示。 依赖于频率的波动（即某些频率附近出现的凹陷）难以归因于任何特定特征，因为误差传播取决于中间矩阵 𝑫 ⁡ ( z ) {\boldsymbol{D}}(z) 在后续 SMD 迭代过程中的重复扰动。 这些扰动在不同频率下可能向参考解累积，也可能偏离参考解累积，因此需要进行单独分析。

sents.en: The dominant eigenvalue and the condition number of the example polynomial matrix are shown in Figure 7 .

sents.en: Although no visible difference can be observed between the eigenvalue estimates obtained using different GEMM models, the difference is non-zero, as illustrated in Figure 8 and 9 .
sents.zh: 尽管使用不同 GEMM 模型得到的特征值估计之间观察不到明显差异，但该差异并非为零，如图 8 和图 9 所示。

sents.en: The frequency-dependent variations i.e., the dip around certain frequencies, are difficult to attribute to any particular feature because the error propagation depends on the repeated perturbation of the intermediate matrix 𝑫 ⁡ ( z ) {\boldsymbol{D}}(z) during subsequent SMD iterations.
sents.zh: 依赖于频率的波动（即某些频率附近出现的凹陷）难以归因于任何特定特征，因为误差传播取决于中间矩阵 𝑫 ⁡ ( z ) {\boldsymbol{D}}(z) 在后续 SMD 迭代过程中的重复扰动。

sents.en: These perturbations may either accumulate towards or away from the reference solution at different frequencies, and therefore, require a separate analysis.
sents.zh: 这些扰动在不同频率下可能向参考解累积，也可能偏离参考解累积，因此需要进行单独分析。

paragraphs.en: The absolute difference between the GEMM models, presented in Fig. 9 , we can see that MI210 architecture exhibits comparatively larger differences from the other models, which may be attributed to its sequential fused multiply-add (SFMA) implementation and lack of subnormal number support. For fp16 inputs, the B200 shows the smallest difference with respect to MI100. This behaviour may be related to the two additional alignment bits available in B200, which provide behaviour closer to correctly rounded arithmetic compared with the other architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 从图 9 展示的 GEMM 模型之间的绝对差值可以看出，MI210 架构与其他模型相比表现出相对较大的差异，这可能归因于其顺序融合乘加（SFMA）实现以及对非规格化数支持的缺失。 对于 fp16 输入，B200 与 MI100 之间的差异最小。 这种行为可能与 B200 提供的两个额外对齐位有关，与其他架构相比，这些对齐位使其行为更接近正确舍入的算术运算。

sents.en: The absolute difference between the GEMM models, presented in Fig. 9 , we can see that MI210 architecture exhibits comparatively larger differences from the other models, which may be attributed to its sequential fused multiply-add (SFMA) implementation and lack of subnormal number support.

paragraphs.en: For bf16 inputs, the MI300 and MI100 models exhibit almost identical behaviour. A possible explanation is that lower product significand precision reduces the difference between the finite and full-precision multi-term adders. This is further supported by the use of RNE rounding in both architectures. For example, bf16 products have lower significand precision, making them less susceptible to differences introduced by the 24-fractional-bit accumulator used by CDNA 3. In contrast, fp16 products have 22-bit significand precision and are therefore more susceptible to such differences. Since the observed difference is small but not exactly zero, this suggests the presence of rare out-of-range alignment cases.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 bf16 输入，MI300 和 MI100 型号表现出几乎相同的行为。 一种可能的解释是，较低的乘积尾数精度缩小了有限精度与全精度多项加法器之间的差异。 两种架构都使用 RNE 舍入这一点进一步支持了这一解释。 例如，bf16 乘积的尾数精度较低，因此不易受到 CDNA 3 所使用的 24 位小数位累加器引入的差异的影响。 相比之下，fp16 乘积具有 22 位尾数精度，因此更容易受到此类差异的影响。 由于观察到的差异很小但不完全为零，这表明存在罕见的超出范围的移位对齐情况。

sents.en: For bf16 inputs, the MI300 and MI100 models exhibit almost identical behaviour.
sents.zh: 对于 bf16 输入，MI300 和 MI100 型号表现出几乎相同的行为。

paragraphs.en: It should be noted that these results are not conclusive. For a different polynomial matrix, the observed behaviour may differ because the iterative nature of the SMD algorithm causes numerical perturbations to be repeatedly propagated through subsequent iterations. These perturbations may lead the algorithm either closer to or further from the reference output at each frequency. Nevertheless, this example demonstrates that small numerical differences introduced by reduced-precision GEMM implementations can influence the final result of iterative matrix algorithms. In subspace-based applications ( Khattak et al., 2025 ) , such deviations may manifest as subspace leakage, where errors in the estimated eigenvectors or invariant subspaces degrade the separation between signal and noise components, thereby deteriorating the performance. In NN-based polynomial eigenvalue extraction ( Hassan et al., 2024 ) , these differences may be more pronounced if both the SMD algorithm and NN training and inference are performed on the matrix multiplier across different GPU architectures. Experiments with fp8 precision were also conducted; however, the estimated dominant eigenvalues exhibited significantly larger deviations from the double-precision reference. Therefore, fp8 precision is considered unsuitable for the considered example case.
paragraphs.zh: 需要注意的是，这些结果并不是决定性的。 对于不同的多项式矩阵，观察到的行为可能有所不同，因为 SMD 算法的迭代特性会导致数值扰动在后续迭代中被反复传播。 这些扰动在每个频率处可能使算法更接近或更远离参考输出。 尽管如此，该示例表明，由低精度 GEMM 实现引入的微小数值差异可能会影响迭代矩阵算法的最终结果。 在基于子空间的应用中（Khattak et al., 2025），这种偏差可能表现为子空间泄漏，即估计的特征向量或不变子空间中的误差会降低信号分量与噪声分量之间的分离度，从而使性能劣化。 在基于神经网络的多项式特征值提取中（Hassan et al., 2024），如果 SMD 算法以及神经网络的训练与推理都在不同 GPU 架构上的矩阵乘法器上执行，这些差异可能会更加明显。 还进行了 fp8 精度的实验；然而，所估计的主特征值与双精度参考值相比表现出明显更大的偏差。 因此，对于所考虑的示例情形，fp8 精度被认为是不适用的。

sents.zh: 在基于子空间的应用中（Khattak et al., 2025），这种偏差可能表现为子空间泄漏，即估计的特征向量或不变子空间中的误差会降低信号分量与噪声分量之间的分离度，从而使性能劣化。

paragraphs.en: This example demonstrates that seemingly minor numerical differences in low precision GEMM implementations can propagate through iterative matrix algorithms and influence the final eigenvalue, and therefore the corresponding eigenvector, estimates. Therefore, numerical characteristics of tensor and matrix core architectures must be carefully considered when deploying reduced-precision GEMM operations in signal processing applications.
paragraphs.zh: 本示例表明，低精度 GEMM 实现中看似微小的数值差异会在迭代矩阵算法中传播，并影响最终的特征值以及相应特征向量的估计结果。 因此，在信号处理应用中部署降精度 GEMM 运算时，必须仔细考虑张量与矩阵核心架构的数值特性。

sents.en: This example demonstrates that seemingly minor numerical differences in low precision GEMM implementations can propagate through iterative matrix algorithms and influence the final eigenvalue, and therefore the corresponding eigenvector, estimates.
sents.zh: 本示例表明，低精度 GEMM 实现中看似微小的数值差异会在迭代矩阵算法中传播，并影响最终的特征值以及相应特征向量的估计结果。

sents.en: Therefore, numerical characteristics of tensor and matrix core architectures must be carefully considered when deploying reduced-precision GEMM operations in signal processing applications.
sents.zh: 因此，在信号处理应用中部署降精度 GEMM 运算时，必须仔细考虑张量与矩阵核心架构的数值特性。

paragraphs.en: Matrix multipliers in AMD CDNA 1, CDNA 2, and CDNA 3 architectures support a wide range of low-precision input formats; however, their internal numerical behaviors contain diverse architectural features that are not publicly documented. While prior work has characterized these features ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , we systematically re-determine all features of CDNA 1, 2, and 3. Our results match those reported in the GitHub repository but differ from those reported in ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . We also provide the test vectors used to identify the numerical features, which can be used to characterize future architectures. Additionally, we provide flexible software models of the CDNA 1, 2, and 3 matrix cores that allow users to modify individual numerical features for numerical analysis. The models are validated in MATLAB against GPU results using two sampling strategies, with randomized test suites exceeding 10 7 10^{7} samples for all supported input formats and associated probabilistic upper bounds on the mismatch probability. The models also work in GNU Octave and are accessible within Python-based workflows through available language interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: AMD CDNA 1、CDNA 2 和 CDNA 3 架构中的矩阵乘法器支持多种低精度输入格式；然而，其内部数值行为包含多种未公开文档化的架构特性。 虽然已有先前工作对这些特性进行了刻画（Xie 等，2025），但我们系统地重新确定了 CDNA 1、2 和 3 的全部特性。 我们的结果与 GitHub 仓库中报告的结果一致，但与（Xie 等，2025）中报告的结果不同。 我们还提供了用于识别这些数值特性的测试向量，可用于刻画未来的架构。 此外，我们提供了 CDNA 1、2 和 3 矩阵核心的灵活软件模型，允许用户修改各个数值特性以进行数值分析。 这些模型在 MATLAB 中使用两种采样策略针对 GPU 结果进行了验证，对全部支持的输入格式使用了超过 10^{7} 个样本的随机测试套件，并给出了失配概率的相关概率上界。 这些模型还可以在 GNU Octave 中运行，并可通过可用的语言接口在基于 Python 的工作流中使用。

sents.en: Matrix multipliers in AMD CDNA 1, CDNA 2, and CDNA 3 architectures support a wide range of low-precision input formats; however, their internal numerical behaviors contain diverse architectural features that are not publicly documented.
sents.zh: AMD CDNA 1、CDNA 2 和 CDNA 3 架构中的矩阵乘法器支持多种低精度输入格式；然而，其内部数值行为包含多种未公开文档化的架构特性。

sents.zh: 虽然已有先前工作对这些特性进行了刻画（Xie 等，2025），但我们系统地重新确定了 CDNA 1、2 和 3 的全部特性。

sents.zh: 我们的结果与 GitHub 仓库中报告的结果一致，但与（Xie 等，2025）中报告的结果不同。

sents.en: We also provide the test vectors used to identify the numerical features, which can be used to characterize future architectures.
sents.zh: 我们还提供了用于识别这些数值特性的测试向量，可用于刻画未来的架构。

sents.en: Additionally, we provide flexible software models of the CDNA 1, 2, and 3 matrix cores that allow users to modify individual numerical features for numerical analysis.
sents.zh: 此外，我们提供了 CDNA 1、2 和 3 矩阵核心的灵活软件模型，允许用户修改各个数值特性以进行数值分析。

sents.en: The models are validated in MATLAB against GPU results using two sampling strategies, with randomized test suites exceeding 10 7 10^{7} samples for all supported input formats and associated probabilistic upper bounds on the mismatch probability.
sents.zh: 这些模型在 MATLAB 中使用两种采样策略针对 GPU 结果进行了验证，对全部支持的输入格式使用了超过 10^{7} 个样本的随机测试套件，并给出了失配概率的相关概率上界。

paragraphs.en: Our testing analysis reveals that the numerical features of AMD CDNA matrix cores vary significantly across generations and differ fundamentally from previously reported behaviors of NVIDIA GPU tensor cores. Specifically, CDNA 1 employs full-precision accumulation, CDNA 2 implements sequential FMA-based pair-wise accumulation approach, while CDNA 3 introduces a distinct numerical behavior that differs from both earlier AMD architectures and NVIDIA implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的测试分析表明，AMD CDNA 矩阵核心的数值特性在不同代际之间存在显著差异，并且与先前报道的 NVIDIA GPU 张量核心的行为有根本不同。 具体而言，CDNA 1 采用全精度累加，CDNA 2 实现了基于顺序 FMA 的两两累加方法，而 CDNA 3 则引入了一种独特的数值行为，既不同于早期的 AMD 架构，也不同于 NVIDIA 的实现。

sents.en: Our testing analysis reveals that the numerical features of AMD CDNA matrix cores vary significantly across generations and differ fundamentally from previously reported behaviors of NVIDIA GPU tensor cores.
sents.zh: 我们的测试分析表明，AMD CDNA 矩阵核心的数值特性在不同代际之间存在显著差异，并且与先前报道的 NVIDIA GPU 张量核心的行为有根本不同。

sents.en: Specifically, CDNA 1 employs full-precision accumulation, CDNA 2 implements sequential FMA-based pair-wise accumulation approach, while CDNA 3 introduces a distinct numerical behavior that differs from both earlier AMD architectures and NVIDIA implementations.
sents.zh: 具体而言，CDNA 1 采用全精度累加，CDNA 2 实现了基于顺序 FMA 的两两累加方法，而 CDNA 3 则引入了一种独特的数值行为，既不同于早期的 AMD 架构，也不同于 NVIDIA 的实现。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we demonstrate the practical impact of these numerical differences through two application scenarios: multi-word arithmetic and polynomial matrix algebra. In both cases, small variations in matrix multiplication behavior can accumulate over repeated operations and lead to different computational outcomes. These examples emphasize the importance of understanding the numerical characteristics of hardware accelerators when developing applications.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们通过两个应用场景——多词算术和多项式矩阵代数——来展示这些数值差异的实际影响。 在这两种情况下，矩阵乘法行为的微小差异会在重复运算中不断累积，并导致不同的计算结果。 这些例子强调了在开发应用程序时理解硬件加速器数值特性的重要性。

sents.en: Finally, we demonstrate the practical impact of these numerical differences through two application scenarios: multi-word arithmetic and polynomial matrix algebra.
sents.zh: 最后，我们通过两个应用场景——多词算术和多项式矩阵代数——来展示这些数值差异的实际影响。

sents.en: In both cases, small variations in matrix multiplication behavior can accumulate over repeated operations and lead to different computational outcomes.
sents.zh: 在这两种情况下，矩阵乘法行为的微小差异会在重复运算中不断累积，并导致不同的计算结果。

sents.en: These examples emphasize the importance of understanding the numerical characteristics of hardware accelerators when developing applications.
sents.zh: 这些例子强调了在开发应用程序时理解硬件加速器数值特性的重要性。
